title: Subprocess Sandbox Boundary & Dynamic Plugin Isolation

claims.assertion: Untrusted or externally ingested plugins must execute in isolated subprocess sandboxes via JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout, reserving in-process execution strictly for trusted core plugins

context: Executing dynamically loaded plugins, third-party GitHub tools, or untrusted code in the primary agent process risks catastrophic kernel crashes, memory leaks, and state pollution.
distilled_learning: Enforce SubprocessExecutor as the default sandbox strategy for all dynamic plugins. Communicate with the child process exclusively via line-delimited JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout with strict asyncio timeout guards (30s default) and automated teardown lifecycle management.
